newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Xylan off on Q2 outlook.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Xylan off on Q2 outlook.

text.p: Xylan Corp's announcement early Tuesday of an expected decline in second quarter results versus the prior period drove the company's shares sharply lower before the market open, traders said.
In heavy third market trade, stock in the computer-networking equipment company tumbled to 13-1/2 from 17-1/4, they said.
Xylan said it expects second quarter results to be below the first quarter's $48 million in revenues and per-share earnings of $0.13.
In the year-ago second quarter, Xylan posted revenue of $28.2 million and earnings of $0.06 per share.

The second quarter, ending June 30, has been impacted by lower-than-expected orders from a large OEM customer, material availability for its ATM switch product, and lower-than-expected shipments of its new Ethernet/Fast Ethernet products, the company said.

Shares in Rare Hospitality International Inc also were for sale before the market open, abandoned by investors after announcing yesterday that it sees second quarter earnings below analysts' estimates, partly as a result of increased restaurant food and labor costs.
In pre-open trade, the shares were down to 11-3/8 from 16-1/16 at Monday's Nasdaq close.
Earnings for the period are forecast at $0.16 to $0.18 per share, below the $0.25 per share to $0.27 per share estimates of analysts following the company, Rare said.
